verdict.rationale: Recurly can be driven headlessly through its API: official client libraries ship in seven languages (Ruby, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, PHP, Go), entitlements can be checked in real time via the API, and webhooks deliver event notifications. That supports scripted automation, but nothing documents a CLI, CI pipeline usage, or a test environment for automated runs. missing for 10: an official CLI, CI/pipeline-specific documentation, a test-mode or sandbox for automated subscription testing, independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
